details.description: Sanitized mechanical details only; secrets and raw image/task content are forbidden by policy.

serviceStatus.description: HTTP status of the classified service response.

serviceCode.description: Allowlisted service body code; other codes are dropped.

serviceMessage.description: Sanitized service error text for HTTP 400, 409 and 422 on operations only; the API key is redacted.

model.description: The premium model the service refused until the wallet is topped up (SERVICE_PREMIUM_MODEL_LOCKED).

tier.description: The service tier of that premium model.

remote.description: True when a hosted run was cancelled by the service rather than by this process.

session.description: Live-run session UUID recorded in the local run journal.

resumable.description: True when the run continues on the service after the client stopped following it (exit 21); details.resumeArgv follows it again and details.cancelArgv stops it. Never resubmit to resume.

resumeArgv.description: Arguments after the product name that recover this run without starting a second one: for exit 21, `cli run watch` of the run; for RUN_SUBMISSION_AMBIGUOUS (exit 22), the same `cli run submit` with the same --session and --detach, which the service answers with the session's existing run.

suggestedArgv.description: Arguments after the product name of the command the Action names: a corrected copy of the rejected invocation, or a follow-up such as a listing or help rendered by the same renderer as resumeArgv. For machine output it keeps the invocation's --output. Present only on errors whose Action names one command. It is complete, so running it (with details.suggestedStdin on standard input when present) is never itself INVOCATION_INVALID.

suggestedStdin.description: What to pipe into details.suggestedArgv when it reads a --spec-file from standard input: the JSON object of the settings given as options, then a newline. Never present for a secret.

cancelArgv.description: Arguments after the product name that cancel this run with `cli run cancel --yes`.

credentialSource.description: Where the API key of a SERVICE_AUTH_REQUIRED failure came from: the environment variable, the OS credential store, or none.

credentialVariable.description: The environment variable that supplies the API key.

credentialProblem.description: Why authentication failed: no key, a key that fails the strict predicate, or a key the service rejected.

resource.description: The resource a SERVICE_RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND names: its kind (from the operation's manifest notFound entry, or the handler) and the identifier as the caller gave it.

webUrl.description: EXAMPLE_NOT_VIEWABLE: the https address where the example can be read on the web.

message.const: Runner configuration is invalid.

action.const: Correct or remove the reported configuration source or setting, then invoke the `cli config explain` runner operation to verify the repair.

message.description: `Runner invocation is invalid.` for the language and runner commands; a `cli` service command says what was wrong: an unknown command, an unknown option, or another mistake in the command line.

message.const: The OpenProse service is unavailable.

action.const: Check your network connection and retry later.

message.const: OpenProse service authentication is required.

action.description: The taxonomy Action, or the credential-source-specific Action that names the environment variable: an environment key is replaced or unset, a stored key is renewed with login, a missing key names both ways to supply one, an unavailable store names the variable to set instead.

anyOf.const: Run cli auth login, then retry.

anyOf.pattern: ^Set OPENPROSE_API_KEY or run `prose (?:[^`]+ )?cli auth login`, then retry\.$
^Run `prose (?:[^`]+ )?cli auth login` again, or set OPENPROSE_API_KEY, then retry\.$

message.const: The OpenProse service returned an invalid response.

action.const: Retry later and report the sanitized error code if it persists.

message.const: The operating system credential store is unavailable.

action.description: The taxonomy Action, or the credential-source-specific Action that names the environment variable: an environment key is replaced or unset, a stored key is renewed with login, a missing key names both ways to supply one, an unavailable store names the variable to set instead.

anyOf.const: Unlock or configure the operating system credential store, then retry.

anyOf.pattern: ^Set OPENPROSE_API_KEY for this command, or unlock or configure the operating system credential store, then retry\.$

anyOf.description: macOS: a key saved by an earlier build that the keychain will not release without a prompt (shared/fixtures/credentials/macos-security.v1.json).
anyOf.const: Run the command in a desktop session and allow access in the macOS keychain prompt once, or set OPENPROSE_API_KEY for this command.

message.const: Device authorization failed.

action.const: Run login again and authorize the displayed code.

message.const: Device authorization expired.

action.const: Run login again to obtain a new code.

message.const: This service operation requires explicit confirmation.

action.const: Rerun the same command with --yes to confirm, or with --preview to see what it would do without sending anything.

message.const: The OpenProse service rejected the request.

action.description: The taxonomy Action, or one that names only the details present (reason, serviceMessage, serviceCode), or, when none is present, the operation's help (also details.suggestedArgv).

anyOf.const: Correct the request using whichever of details.reason, details.serviceMessage and details.serviceCode are present, then retry.

anyOf.pattern: ^Correct the request as details\.(reason|serviceMessage|serviceCode)((, | and )details\.(serviceMessage|serviceCode))* describes?, then retry\.$
^The service gave no reason; check the command against `prose [^`]*`, then retry\.$

message.const: The requested OpenProse service resource was not found.

action.description: The taxonomy Action, or one that quotes details.suggestedArgv, the listing command of the missing resource, or names the resource kind when no command lists it. Or, for a name with a close match among your own, the command with that name.

anyOf.pattern: ^Run `prose [^`]*` to find the right [a-z]+, then retry with it\.$
^Check the [a-z]+ identifier named in Detail, then retry with the right one\.$

message.const: This capability is not available for this account.

action.const: Check your plan or organization, or contact OpenProse support.

message.const: The OpenProse wallet balance is insufficient for this operation.

action.const: Add credit with the `cli wallet topup` or `cli wallet redeem` runner operation, then retry.

message.const: This model is a premium model that unlocks with any wallet top-up.

action.description: The taxonomy Action, or the top-up preview that unlocks the model (also details.suggestedArgv), for details.serviceCode paid_top_up_required (or paid_model_required from older servers) or a premium model in the `cli model list` catalog.

anyOf.const: Top up the wallet with any amount using the `cli wallet topup` runner operation, then retry.

anyOf.pattern: ^Top up the wallet with any amount to unlock premium models; preview a top-up with `prose [^`]*`\.$

message.const: The OpenProse account is suspended.

action.const: Contact OpenProse support; retrying will not succeed.

message.const: The OpenProse service reported a conflicting write.

action.description: The taxonomy Action, or the ended-run Action of `cli run input`: the run takes no more instructions, so it names `cli run show RUN_ID` (also details.suggestedArgv) instead of a retry.

anyOf.const: Read the current state of the resource, reconcile the change, then retry.

anyOf.pattern: ^Do not retry; the run takes no more instructions\. Read its outcome with `prose [^`]* cli run show run_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}`\.$

message.const: This operation needs a linked GitHub account on the OpenProse account.

action.const: Link or reconnect GitHub for this account in the OpenProse web app, then retry; the API key itself is valid.

message.const: The OpenProse service response exceeded the client limit.

action.const: Narrow the request, for example with --limit or a more specific identifier, then retry.

message.const: The watch deadline elapsed before the hosted run finished; the run continues.

action.const: Resume with the `cli run watch` runner operation using details.resumeArgv (details.runId and details.afterSequence); never submit the run again to resume it.

message.const: The hosted run finished without completing successfully.

action.description: The taxonomy Action, or the Action of the cause details.reason names (shared/fixtures/human/run-failure-actions.json): a run that ran out of budget or hit the step limit.

anyOf.const: Inspect the run with the `cli run show` runner operation, correct the program or inputs, then submit again.
Raise the run budget, choose another environment, or check `cli wallet balance`, then submit again.
Simplify the program or split it into steps, then submit again.

message.const: The run submission could not be confirmed and was not repeated.

action.const: List recent runs with the `cli run list` runner operation before submitting again; the local run journal keeps details.session.

message.const: The client stopped following the hosted run before its outcome arrived; the run was not cancelled.

action.const: Resume with the `cli run watch` runner operation using details.resumeArgv (details.runId and details.afterSequence); never submit the run again to resume it.

message.const: The hosted run was cancelled on the service and will not continue.

action.const: Read the cancelled run with the `cli run show` runner operation using details.runId; submit again only to start a new run.

message.const: This example is published outside the OpenProse service and cannot be shown here.

action.const: Read the example on the web at details.webUrl when it is present, or pick an example that the `cli example list` runner operation does not mark viewOnWeb.
